mutations.name: E1 取到 0 也不重做
E3 重做成功也不算成功
E4 CreateProcessW 改回失败后直接取错误码
mutations.old:
check("CreateProcessW", () => k.CreateProcessW(null, wide(cmdline), null, null, 1, flags, environment,
          cwd === null ? null : wide(cwd), startup, info), falsy);

mutations.name: E5 ctrlBreak 改回直接取错误码
mutations.old: const sent = retryWin32(() => k.GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(CTRL_BREAK_EVENT, pid), falsy, lastError);
mutations.new: const sent = k.GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(CTRL_BREAK_EVENT, pid) ? { value: 1 } : { winerror: k.GetLastError() };

mutations.name: E6 check 不经 retryWin32
mutations.new:
const value = attempt();
    const result = failed(value) ? { winerror: lastError() } : { value };

mutations.name: E7 CreateDirectoryW 改回直接取错误码
mutations.old: return outcome(retryWin32(() => call.CreateDirectoryW(ffi.ptr(path), null), falsy, lastError));
mutations.new: return call.CreateDirectoryW(ffi.ptr(path), null) ? null : outcome({ winerror: call.GetLastError() });

mutations.name: E8 statPath 的 FindFirstFileW 改回直接取错误码
mutations.old: const found = retryWin32(() => call.FindFirstFileW(ffi.ptr(name), ffi.ptr(data)), invalidHandle, lastError);
mutations.new:
const handle = call.FindFirstFileW(ffi.ptr(name), ffi.ptr(data));
      const found = invalidHandle(handle) ? { winerror: call.GetLastError() } : { value: handle };
